description: Add AI-generated burned-in subtitles to a talking video (public URL). Uses the user's saved caption style and brand color unless overridden. The captioned video appears in the user's Todo list when ready (1-3 minutes).

captionStyle.description: Caption style override. Defaults to the user's saved preference.

editMode.description: full retains every source section (default); highlights selects and shortens only when requested.

prompt.description: The customer's original creative brief and constraints.

silenceMode.description: auto permits dead-air cleanup; off preserves source timing and pauses.

targetPlatforms.description: Selected channels; omit for eligible connected channels, empty for draft only.

videoUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of the video to caption

name: process_video
title: Caption Video
